title: Wikiddle - Daily Wikipedia Puzzle: Follow the Links, Find the Article
description: Every day, a new mystery Wikipedia article to find. Make guesses, follow the shared links, fall down the Wikipedia rabbit hole, and track down the answer.
howto_text_before:
Every day, a random Wikipedia article is chosen as the mystery article. Your goal is to find it.

Every Wikipedia article contains links to other articles. When you guess an article, the game shows you which other articles are linked by both your guess and the mystery article. Use them to narrow down the mystery article.

Here's an example game in progress, after 3 guesses:
howto_text_after:
If you're stuck, hit the hint button: to reveal a random link from the mystery article.

There's no guess limit and no timer: explore Wikipedia freely and enjoy yourself.
howto_annotation_last_guess: Your most recent guess always appears here, at the top of the list.
howto_annotation_mystery: This card represents the mystery article. Its title stays hidden until you find it. Every time you make a guess, the links it has in common with the mystery article are added here.
howto_annotation_previous_guesses: The score next to each guess is the number of links in common with the mystery article. Guesses are sorted by score: the higher, the closer. A blue title means the guess is itself a link on the mystery article.
midnight_message: Midnight has passed and the daily mystery article has changed. Unfortunately your current game can't continue. Ready for today's article?
error_message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
all_links_found_error: You already have all the links!
all_links_found: You have found all the links...!
